originalReview.notes: The exact circa-1900 archival photograph shows the open end of the curved shed spanning the sunken tracks, the perimeter brick wings and the clock tower and smaller towers at its ends.

review.method: Exact Qualla current and archival station exteriors, mapped main building and museum wing, architect’s survey
review.notes: Both Qualla stories refer to the same exterior. The exact 2025 CC0 photograph supplies the restored brick and cream trim and tower colors. The exact archival Gaensly photograph supplies the train shed and pavilions. The institution confirms the restoration and the architectural survey identifies shed span and tower height.
